rationale: searchPatterns.spec.js is @enterprise-tagged and covers the data-dependent patterns-extraction happy path (ingestion + FTS + enable_log_patterns_extraction), not the OSS client-side multi-stream guard. The multiselect/share-url specs exercise multi-stream selection but never enter patterns mode. No existing spec asserts the guard's toast or its skip-before-API behavior, so a brand-new OSS spec is required; run-context spec_path is searchPatternsMultiStream.spec.js, which must be registered under the Logs-Features shard in ci_matrix.json.
